item.title: BCCI Announces Rs 131 Crore Prize Money To Team India For Winning T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: India have been handed a massive prize money of Rs 131 crore by the BCCI, after they lifted their record third T20 World Cup title in 2026 after defeating New Zealand in the final.

item.title: EXPLAINED: Why Nepal Have Cancelled All CWC League 2 Matches Vs Oman And UAE
item.description: Nepal's cricketing journey was set to resume with the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2, featuring matches against Oman and UAE. However, the opening match in Kathmandu has been postponed due to the tense situation in the Middle East stemming from the Iran-Israel/USA conflict.

item.title: Aneet Padda To Play Madhubala In Biopic? Details Of Shakti Shalini Star's Next Project Revealed - Report
item.description: After reports of Kiara Advani not leading legendary actress Madhubala's upcoming biopic, the filmmakers seem to have finally locked the actress. According to a recent report, Saiyaara actress Aneet Padda has been roped in to play Madhubala's role in her biopic backed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali.

item.title: The Gulf's Bigger Crisis Isn't Oil — It's What Comes After
item.description: An Iranian drone allegedly struck a desalination plant in Bahrain, raising fears that water infrastructure could become a new target in the Iran-Israel-US war. Experts warn Gulf cities rely almost entirely on desalinated water.

item.title: 'Jasprit Bumrah Is Like Waqar + Wasim': Pakistan Great Zaheer Abbas' Sterling Tribute | EXCLUSIVE
item.description: In the 21st century, cricket has changed significantly and T20 is a format that has always favoured batters. And the fact that Jasprit Bumrah has been compared to this iconic duo speaks volumes about his ability.

item.title: Delhi Court Initiates PO Proceedings Against NBFC Executive Director in Multi-Crore Fraud Case
item.description: Delhi Saket court has initiated proceedings to declare Exclusive Capital Ltd. Executive Director Achal Kumar Jindal a proclaimed offender in a multi-crore fraud case after non-bailable warrants against him remained unexecuted.

item.title: LPG Shortage Hits Restaurants In Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai — Govt Invokes ESMA
item.description: The Centre has invoked the Essential Commodities Act to ensure regular supply of cooking gas after a commercial LPG shortage linked to global energy disruptions amid the Iran–Israel conflict.
